columns.name: PROCESS_ID
columns.description: This is the primary key for the process table.

columns.name: NAME
columns.description: The descriptive name of the process.

columns.name: START_TIME
columns.description: The start timestamp of the process as a single integer value.

columns.name: FINISH_TIME
columns.description: The finish timestamp of the process as a single integer value.

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: The current status of the process - not started, in progress, completed, or failed.

columns.name: PARAMETERS
columns.description: The parameters passed to the process.

columns.name: JOB_ID
columns.description: The ID of the job run the process is associated with.

columns.name: PERCENTAGE
columns.description: Fills in the percentage of existing rows in process table

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
